boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Christopher Newport University
boards.description: An under-21-safe guide to late-night dining and study fuel near Christopher Newport University, featuring on-campus staples and nearby 24-hour favorites.

cards.title: Einstein's Café
cards.subtitle: Trible Library
cards.notes: Fuel your late-night study sessions with fresh-brewed coffee and espresso right inside the library. It is the primary on-campus spot for late caffeine runs.
cards.short_summary: Located in the Trible Library, this café serves coffee and snacks to students studying late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: Einstein's Café is located in the Trible Library and serves as a late-night dining option, typically serving food until 12 a.m. Sunday-Thursday.
cards.source_title: On-Campus Eateries | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Open until 12 a.m. Sunday through Thursday during the academic semester.

cards.title: Wawa
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Avenue
cards.notes: A quintessential 24/7 stop for Captains seeking custom hoagies, Sizzlis, and late-night snacks just a short drive from campus.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience hub known for made-to-order hoagies and a wide variety of late-night food options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wawa located at 12095 Jefferson Ave is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, offering freshly brewed coffee and a full hoagie menu.
cards.source_title: 12095 jefferson ave - Wawa
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Cook Out
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Avenue
cards.notes: Famous for the 'Cook Out Tray' and over 40 milkshake flavors, this drive-thru is a staple for affordable late-night meals.
cards.short_summary: A popular Southern fast-food chain offering burgers, BBQ, and shakes until the early morning hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Out locations typically close at 3:00 AM Sunday-Thursday and 4:00 AM Friday-Saturday, serving their full menu until closing.
cards.source_title: Cook Out - Virginia
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 3 a.m. or 4 a.m. depending on the day.

cards.title: IHOP
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Avenue
cards.notes: The go-to destination for 2 a.m. pancake stacks and breakfast platters when you need a sit-down meal after a long night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour breakfast specialist serving pancakes, omelettes, and burgers at all hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The IHOP at 11745 Jefferson Ave is open 24 hours a day, offering a full menu including world-famous pancakes.
cards.source_title: IHOP® Breakfast in Newport News, VA on 11745 Jefferson Ave
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Avenue
cards.notes: Satisfy your late-night sweet tooth with warm cookies delivered until 3 a.m., a favorite for dorm-room study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A bakery specializing in warm cookie delivery and walk-in service late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies offers delivery and in-store pickup until 3 a.m. at most locations, including Newport News.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies | Warm Cookie Delivery & Baked Treats Until Late Night
cards.access_notes: Open until 3 a.m. for delivery and pickup.

cards.title: 7-Eleven
cards.subtitle: Warwick Boulevard
cards.notes: Located just steps from the edge of campus, this 24-hour spot is perfect for a quick Slurpee or snack run at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store offering snacks, hot food, and beverages within walking distance of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 12330 Warwick Blvd is a 24-hour location providing convenience items and hot food.
cards.source_title: 12330 Warwick Blvd in NEWPORT NEWS, VA - 7-Eleven
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Chanello's Pizza
cards.subtitle: Hiden Boulevard
cards.notes: A local favorite for late-night pizza delivery, known for serving the CNU community with hot pies well past midnight.
cards.short_summary: A regional pizza chain offering delivery and takeout with late-night hours catering to students.
cards.evidence_claim: Chanello's Pizza (CNU location) provides delivery services to the university area and maintains late-night operating hours.
cards.source_title: Locations - Chanello's Pizza
cards.access_notes: Open late for delivery; check specific daily hours on their website.

cards.title: Plaza Azteca
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Avenue
cards.notes: Enjoy a late dinner of authentic Mexican cuisine. It's a popular spot for groups to gather before the night ends.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant offering a full menu of tacos, enchiladas, and margaritas with late evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Plaza Azteca on Jefferson Ave is open until 10 p.m. Monday-Thursday and 11 p.m. Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Jefferson | The No.1 Delicious Shortcut to Mexico! - Plaza Azteca
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.

cards.title: Panera Bread
cards.subtitle: Warwick Boulevard
cards.notes: A reliable spot for a late-evening soup or sandwich in the CNU Village, offering a quiet atmosphere for evening study.
cards.short_summary: A bakery-café located in the CNU Village serving sandwiches, salads, and pastries until 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The Panera Bread at 12368 Warwick Blvd is open until 9 p.m. daily, serving the CNU community.
cards.source_title: Panera Bread at 12368 Warwick Boulevard Newport News, VA
cards.access_notes: Open until 9 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Tropical Smoothie Cafe
cards.subtitle: Warwick Boulevard
cards.notes: Grab a refreshing smoothie or a flatbread sandwich after an evening workout or study session in the CNU Village.
cards.short_summary: A health-conscious café offering smoothies, wraps, and sandwiches with evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tropical Smoothie Cafe at 12368 Warwick Blvd is open until 9 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Tropical Smoothie Cafe in Newport News, VA - 12368 Warwick Boulevard
cards.access_notes: Open until 9 p.m. daily.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the quiet corners, specialized study lounges, and scenic retreats where Christopher Newport University students actually spend their time between classes.

cards.title: Trible Library Balconies
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Study Terraces
cards.notes: Head to the second or third floors to access these outdoor terraces. They offer fresh air and a quiet alternative to the Great Lawn for focused afternoon study sessions.
cards.short_summary: Elevated outdoor study terraces overlooking the campus core.
cards.evidence_claim: The Trible Library features outdoor reading terraces on the second floor that are popular for quiet study and people-watching.
cards.source_title: Trible Library Expansion - Glavé & Holmes Architecture
cards.access_notes: Open during library operating hours; accessible via the second and third floor reading rooms.

cards.title: The Luter Turret
cards.subtitle: Third Floor Octagonal Atrium
cards.notes: Take the elevator to the third floor of Luter Hall to find this octagonal lounge. It is a favorite for rainy days due to its comfortable seating and panoramic views.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, scenic lounge located in the top-floor turret of Luter Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Luter Turret, also known as the Luter Atrium, is a third-floor octagonal structure used by students as a comfortable study space.
cards.source_title: What is the best academic building on campus? - The Captain's Log
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of Luter Hall; open during academic building hours.

cards.title: The Ferg Garden
cards.subtitle: Hidden Arts Courtyard
cards.notes: Find this courtyard off the main hallway in the Ferguson Center classroom wing. The bubbling fountain provides excellent white noise for reading or memorizing scripts.
cards.short_summary: A secluded courtyard garden with a fountain inside the Ferguson Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ferguson Center contains a courtyard garden with a fountain that students use as a quiet study and relaxation spot.
cards.source_title: The Arts at CNU | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Accessible through the classroom wing of the Ferguson Center for the Arts.

cards.title: Pope Chapel Quiet Rooms
cards.subtitle: Interfaith Meditation Spaces
cards.notes: When not in use for meetings, these seminar rooms offer a silent environment for deep focus. The lobby also features comfortable seating for quiet reflection.
cards.short_summary: Silent seminar and meditation rooms within the campus chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Pope Chapel includes two seminar rooms and a central lobby designed for meditation, prayer, and quiet meetings.
cards.source_title: Pope Chapel - Glavé & Holmes Architecture
cards.access_notes: Open to all students for quiet reflection and study when events are not scheduled.

cards.title: Gosnold Lawn
cards.subtitle: Alternative Green Space
cards.notes: Located between Santoro and Forbes Halls, this lawn is typically less crowded than the Great Lawn. It is ideal for sunbathing or small group discussions in peace.
cards.short_summary: A quieter alternative to the Great Lawn for outdoor relaxation.
cards.evidence_claim: Gosnold Lawn is identified as a quieter, less-trafficked outdoor relaxation spot compared to the central Great Lawn.
cards.source_title: 5 Best On-Campus Places to Relax Outdoors – Spring Edition - The Captain's Log
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space located between Santoro Hall and Forbes Hall.

cards.title: Forbes Science Alcoves
cards.subtitle: Integrated Science Center Lounges
cards.notes: Look for the glass-walled study alcoves on the upper floors of Forbes Hall. They provide great views of the campus and are conveniently located near science labs.
cards.short_summary: Modern, glass-walled study areas within the Integrated Science Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Forbes Hall, the integrated science center, includes 160,000 square feet of space featuring dedicated study areas for students.
cards.source_title: Department of Biology | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours; primarily used by science students but open to all.

cards.title: Warwick River Fireplace Lobbies
cards.subtitle: Residential Social Spaces
cards.notes: The ground floor lobbies of Warwick River Hall feature fireplaces and comfortable seating. They are excellent spots for meeting friends before heading to the DSU.
cards.short_summary: Gracious residential lobbies with fireplaces and social seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Warwick River Hall features entrance lobbies with reception desks, comfortable seating, and fireplaces for social or academic use.
cards.source_title: Warwick River Residence Hall - Glavé & Holmes Architecture
cards.access_notes: Accessible to residents and their guests; ground floor areas are often used for student meetings.

cards.title: McMurran Second Floor Lounge
cards.subtitle: Humanities Study Spot
cards.notes: This second-floor area is a convenient pit-stop between humanities classes. It features vending machines and seating for quick review sessions.
cards.short_summary: A functional study lounge located in the heart of the humanities building.
cards.evidence_claim: McMurran Hall is noted for its convenient second-floor lounge area and proximity to vending machines for students.
cards.source_title: What is the best academic building on campus? - The Captain's Log
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; located on the second floor near the elevator.

cards.title: The Library Prayer Room
cards.subtitle: Dedicated Reflection Space
cards.notes: Located within the Trible Library, this dedicated space provides a quiet area for daily prayers and spiritual reflection for the campus community.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet space for prayer and reflection inside the library.
cards.evidence_claim: A dedicated prayer room for Muslim students, faculty, and staff was recently inaugurated within the Trible Library.
cards.source_title: A Spiritual Home Away From Home | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Trible Library; open during library operating hours.

cards.title: Ratcliffe Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Residential Tree Seats
cards.notes: The courtyards bordering Ratcliffe Hall feature unique 'tree seats' and shaded benches. It is a peaceful spot to relax away from the main campus thoroughfares.
cards.short_summary: A shaded residential courtyard with natural seating areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The courtyards surrounding Ratcliffe Hall are known for their 'tree seats' and provide a quiet place for students to relax.
cards.source_title: The Rooms Less Traveled: 4 of the Coolest Places to Study On Campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor courtyard area accessible to the campus community.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover the best social activities and public spaces at Christopher Newport University that require no admission or purchase, from world-class art galleries to serene campus gardens.

cards.entity_name: Mary M. Torggler Fine Arts Center
cards.title: Explore World-Class Art
cards.subtitle: Free admission to all galleries
cards.notes: Walk through the soaring glass rotunda to view rotating exhibitions from global and local artists. Admission is always free for students and the general public.
cards.short_summary: A premier university art museum offering free access to professional galleries and student showcases.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Torggler is free for all; exhibitions are open to the public Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Visit | Torggler Fine Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday-Saturday 10 a.m. - 5 p.m. and Sunday 12 - 5 p.m. Closed Mondays.

cards.title: Relax on the Great Lawn
cards.subtitle: The heart of campus social life
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or a frisbee to this expansive green space. It is the primary spot for outdoor studying, sunbathing, and major free community events like the annual tree lighting.
cards.short_summary: The central outdoor hub of CNU, perfect for casual recreation and large-scale university gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Great Lawn is a public campus space used for free events like the annual Holiday Happening tree lighting.
cards.source_title: CNU's Holiday Happening | Ferguson Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for student use; public access during university events.

cards.title: Study in the Trible Library
cards.subtitle: Publicly accessible research hub
cards.notes: Utilize the extensive quiet study zones and guest computer terminals. Virginia residents over 18 can even obtain a free community patron card to borrow items.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art library offering free study spaces and guest resources for students and the community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Trible Library is free to use for the public, including guest computer access and free print cards for community patrons.
cards.source_title: I'm not a student. Can I use the library? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Public access available during standard operating hours; check website for seasonal changes.

cards.title: Find Quiet at Pope Chapel
cards.subtitle: Interfaith space for reflection
cards.notes: Visit this welcoming interfaith space for a moment of silence or meditation. It serves as a central hub for spiritual growth and communal worship for all faiths.
cards.short_summary: A serene campus chapel providing a quiet environment for prayer, meditation, and interfaith gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Pope Chapel is a welcoming space for people of all faiths, providing a place for meditation, prayer, and meetings.
cards.source_title: A Spiritual Home Away From Home | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Open daily for meditation and scheduled services.

cards.title: Study with a View
cards.subtitle: The Luter Hall Atrium
cards.notes: Head to the third floor of Luter Hall to find the 'Turret,' a lavishly furnished octagonal room offering panoramic views of the Great Lawn and a quiet atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A scenic and comfortable indoor study lounge located at the top of Luter Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Luter Turret is a comfy room on the third floor of Luter Hall used by students for studying.
cards.source_title: "The Rooms Less Traveled": 4 of the Coolest Places to Study On Campus
cards.access_notes: Accessible via elevator or stairs to the third floor during building hours.

cards.title: Relax in the Secret Garden
cards.subtitle: Outdoor study nook
cards.notes: Find this hidden courtyard off the main hallway of the Ferguson Center. It features a bubbling fountain and lush greenery, providing natural white noise for focused work.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, plant-filled courtyard garden tucked away within the Ferguson Center for the Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Ferg-Garden' is a courtyard garden with a fountain located off the main hallway in the Ferguson Center classroom area.
cards.source_title: "The Rooms Less Traveled": 4 of the Coolest Places to Study On Campus
cards.access_notes: Accessible through the classroom wing of the Ferguson Center during academic hours.

cards.title: Connect at the DSU
cards.subtitle: Inclusive social lounge
cards.notes: Hang out in this comfortable space in the David Student Union designed for cultural exchange. It features couches and tables for students to gather and foster friendships.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student lounge in the David Student Union focused on inclusivity and community building.
cards.evidence_claim: The multicultural center in the David Student Union is an inviting space where Captains can come together to hang out.
cards.source_title: New Space for Diversity to Thrive | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Located within the David Student Union; open during standard union hours.

cards.title: Visit the Community Garden
cards.subtitle: Public planting space
cards.notes: Stroll through the community garden on East Campus to see local vegetables and flowers. It serves as a green retreat for students and faculty to engage with nature.
cards.short_summary: A community-focused garden space on the east side of campus for planting and relaxation.
cards.evidence_claim: A community garden on East Campus is available for the planting of vegetables and flowers.
cards.source_title: Campus Garden to Harvest Research | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community for walking and viewing.

cards.title: Work Out for Free
cards.subtitle: Student fitness and recreation
cards.notes: Current students can access the Trieshmann Health and Fitness Pavilion and auxiliary gyms at no extra cost. Just bring your Captains Card to enter the turnstiles.
cards.short_summary: Free gym and fitness facility access for all currently enrolled CNU students.
cards.evidence_claim: Current CNU students are eligible for free memberships and access to the Freeman Center Trieshmann Health and Fitness Pavilion.
cards.source_title: Membership and Facility Policies | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Open Mon-Thu 6:30 a.m. - 11 p.m. during semesters. Captains Card required for entry.

cards.title: Join Thursday Night Trivia
cards.subtitle: Free student social event
cards.notes: Test your knowledge at these regular free social events hosted by the Office of Student Involvement. It is a popular way to connect with peers without spending money.
cards.short_summary: A recurring free social activity for students to compete in trivia and win prizes.
cards.evidence_claim: Thursday Night Trivia and DSU Takeovers are examples of free events provided for students by the Office of Student Involvement.
cards.source_title: Student Involvement - Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the David Student Union; check the campus events calendar for specific dates.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Discover ten distinct study environments across the Christopher Newport University campus, from quiet library reading rooms to active student union lounges.

cards.title: Rosemary Trible Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Trible Library Second Floor
cards.notes: Study in this iconic two-story space featuring natural light from the cupola and access to outdoor reading terraces. Maintain strict quiet for focused academic work.
cards.short_summary: A grand, light-filled quiet study hall in the Trible Library with outdoor terrace access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rosemary Trible Reading Room is a two-story feature on the second floor of the Trible Library with natural light and outdoor reading terraces.
cards.source_title: Trible Library Expansion - Glavé & Holmes Architecture

cards.title: 24/7 Lab (Room 171)
cards.subtitle: Trible Library First Floor
cards.notes: Access this dedicated computer lab and study space at any hour using your student ID. It is located on the first floor of the Trible Library for late-night productivity.
cards.short_summary: A secure, 24-hour computer lab and study area for students within the Trible Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The 24/7 Lab (Room 171) is located in the Trible Library and provides around-the-clock access for students.

cards.title: The Luter Turret

cards.notes: Find a seat in this octagonal atrium at the top of Luter Hall. The space offers comfortable furniture and views overlooking the Great Lawn.
cards.short_summary: An octagonal third-floor atrium in Luter Hall known for its views and comfortable seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Luter Turret, also known as the Luter Atrium, is an octagonal structure on the third floor of Luter Hall used for studying.
cards.source_title: "The Rooms Less Traveled": 4 of the Coolest Places to Study On Campus

cards.title: The Ferg-Garden
cards.subtitle: Ferguson Center Classroom Wing
cards.notes: Study in this enclosed courtyard featuring a bubbling fountain and natural light. It is located off the main hallway in the Ferguson Center classroom area.
cards.short_summary: A quiet outdoor courtyard with a fountain located within the Ferguson Center for the Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Ferg-Garden' is a courtyard located in the Ferguson Center classroom area, featuring a fountain and plants.
cards.source_title: "The Rooms Less Traveled": 4 of the Coolest Places to Study On Campus

cards.title: Einstein's Café
cards.subtitle: Trible Library First Floor
cards.notes: Utilize this social study space for group work or casual reading. It is located near the library entrance and offers coffee and snacks to fuel long sessions.
cards.short_summary: A lively café-style study area on the first floor of the Trible Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Einstein's Café is located in the Trible Library and serves as a location for students to study and gather.
cards.source_title: On-Campus Eateries | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; food service hours may vary by semester.

cards.title: The Crow's Nest
cards.subtitle: David Student Union Third Floor
cards.notes: Head to the third floor of the DSU for a more relaxed study environment. This space is often used for student organization meetings and casual individual work.
cards.short_summary: A multi-purpose student lounge and meeting space on the top floor of the David Student Union.
cards.evidence_claim: The Crow's Nest is located in the David Student Union and is a designated place for student use and meetings.
cards.source_title: Library Etiquette - The Captain's Log
cards.access_notes: Accessible during David Student Union operating hours.

cards.title: Pope Chapel Seminar Rooms
cards.subtitle: Pope Chapel
cards.notes: Seek out the seminar rooms in Pope Chapel for a serene and quiet environment. The chapel is designed for meditation and quiet reflection near the library.
cards.short_summary: Quiet seminar and meeting rooms located within the non-denominational Pope Chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Pope Chapel features two seminar rooms and is located near the Trible Library, providing a place for meditation and meetings.
cards.source_title: Pope Chapel - Glavé & Holmes Architecture
cards.access_notes: Open to students of all faiths for quiet study and meditation when not in use for services.

cards.title: Forbes Hall Informal Learning Areas
cards.subtitle: Mary Brock Forbes Hall
cards.notes: Use the 'science-on-display' corridors and informal learning areas throughout the science complex. These spots are ideal for biology and chemistry students between labs.
cards.short_summary: Modern study nooks and informal learning spaces integrated into the Forbes Hall science complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Forbes Hall includes informal learning areas and student study areas throughout its 160,000 square feet of space.
cards.source_title: Mary Brock Forbes Hall Science Complex - Glavé & Holmes Architecture
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Forbes Hall academic hours.

cards.title: McMurran Hall Lounge
cards.subtitle: McMurran Hall Second Floor
cards.notes: Take advantage of the seating areas and vending machines on the second floor of McMurran Hall. This building is centrally located on the Great Lawn.
cards.short_summary: A convenient study lounge area located on the second floor of McMurran Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: McMurran Hall features lounge areas and a vending machine on the second floor for student use.
cards.source_title: What is the best academic building on campus? - The Captain's Log
cards.access_notes: Open during McMurran Hall academic hours.

cards.title: Warwick River Hall Study Lounges
cards.subtitle: Warwick River Hall
cards.notes: Residents can utilize the study lounges and community kitchens on each floor. These spaces are designed for both social interaction and academic focus.
cards.short_summary: Floor-specific study lounges available to residents of Warwick River Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Warwick River Hall provides study lounges and community kitchens on each floor for its residents.
cards.source_title: Living on Campus - Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Restricted to residents of Warwick River Hall and their guests via card access.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the essential streets and commercial corridors surrounding Christopher Newport University, from immediate campus-adjacent shopping to nearby Newport News districts.

cards.title: The Shoppes at CNU Village
cards.subtitle: Warwick Boulevard
cards.notes: Visit this mixed-use retail center directly on the edge of campus to find student favorites like Panera Bread, Moe's, and Tropical Smoothie Cafe.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent retail hub on Warwick Boulevard featuring popular dining and student services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shoppes at CNU Village is a 25,000 SF retail center located directly on the campus of Christopher Newport University on Warwick Boulevard.
cards.source_title: The Shoppes at CNU Village - Thalhimer
cards.access_notes: Open daily for public retail access; hours vary by individual business.

cards.title: Hidenwood Shopping Center
cards.subtitle: Hiden Boulevard
cards.notes: Walk to this established center at the corner of Warwick and Hiden for grocery runs at Harris Teeter or a quick study break at Starbucks.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood shopping center serving the CNU community with groceries, coffee, and casual dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Hidenwood Shopping Center is an established neighborhood center serving the college community, adjacent to CNU and featuring Harris Teeter and Starbucks.
cards.source_title: Hidenwood Shopping Center - Thalhimer
cards.access_notes: Public shopping center with standard retail hours.

cards.title: Port Warwick
cards.subtitle: Nat Turner Boulevard
cards.notes: Head to this walkable urban village for community events at Styron Square or to dine at local spots like Brickhouse Tavern.
cards.short_summary: A vibrant mixed-use district near campus known for its walkable layout and community green space.
cards.evidence_claim: Port Warwick is a vibrant mixed-use destination with dining, shopping, and residential living located minutes from Christopher Newport University.
cards.source_title: CNU Off-Campus Guide - Visit Newport News

cards.title: City Center at Oyster Point
cards.subtitle: Town Center Drive
cards.notes: Explore this 52-acre business and entertainment district for a movie at the theater or to see the fountain at the heart of the development.
cards.short_summary: A major Newport News destination featuring a large fountain, cinema, and diverse dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: City Center at Oyster Point is a vibrant mixed-use destination with dining, shopping, and a movie theater, offering free parking.
cards.source_title: City Center at Oyster Point

cards.title: Shops at Newport Square
cards.subtitle: J. Clyde Morris Boulevard
cards.notes: Access this commercial strip for essential services and quick bites located just north of the main campus area.
cards.short_summary: A retail plaza on a major thoroughfare providing convenient access to local businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shops at Newport Square Plaza are located on J. Clyde Morris Blvd with close proximity to area retailers and CNU parking.
cards.source_title: Shops At Newport Square Plaza
cards.access_notes: Standard retail plaza access.

cards.title: The Mariners' Museum Park
cards.subtitle: Museum Drive
cards.notes: Walk the 5-mile Noland Trail for a scenic run or quiet study spot overlooking the James River, located just blocks from campus.
cards.short_summary: A massive park adjacent to campus featuring the Noland Trail and maritime history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mariners' Museum Park and the 5-mile Noland Trail are located one block from the CNU campus.
cards.source_title: Things To Do | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: The park and Noland Trail are free and open to the public daily from sunrise to sunset.

cards.title: Prince Drew Road
cards.subtitle: Prince Drew Road
cards.notes: Walk this residential corridor bordering the east side of campus, which connects student housing areas to the main academic grounds.
cards.short_summary: A key residential street bordering the university campus and housing facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Prince Drew Road is a street bordering the CNU campus and is part of the university's land acquisition and expansion history.
cards.source_title: CNU Expansion Map | Newport News Library, VA

cards.title: Shoe Lane

cards.title: Hilton Village

cards.notes: Visit this historic district for unique local shops and the Cups & Claws cat cafe, a popular off-campus spot for students to unwind.
cards.short_summary: A historic shopping and residential district located a short drive south of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Hilton Village is a popular neighborhood near CNU offering restaurants and shops like the Cups & Claws cat cafe.
cards.source_title: CNU Off-Campus Guide - Visit Newport News

cards.title: University Place
cards.subtitle: University Place
cards.notes: Walk this short corridor connecting Warwick Boulevard to the heart of campus, passing by the Trible Library and David Student Union.
cards.short_summary: A central campus thoroughfare connecting the main entrance to core academic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: University Place is a street on the CNU campus connecting Warwick Blvd to major campus buildings like the Trible Library.

cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible pedestrian-friendly street on campus.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: From tossing lucky pennies into the Geese Fountain to the campus-wide 'speaking tradition,' Christopher Newport University maintains a distinct culture of honor and community through these unique rituals.

cards.title: Tossing the Lucky Penny
cards.subtitle: Geese Fountain
cards.notes: Receive a lucky penny at Convocation after signing the Honor Code. Keep it until graduation day, then toss it into the Geese Fountain to symbolize your honorable journey.
cards.short_summary: A four-year ritual where students keep a penny from their first week until graduation.
cards.evidence_claim: Incoming freshmen receive a penny at Convocation and throw it into the Geese Fountain on commencement day.
cards.source_title: Traditions | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: The fountain is located on the Great Lawn and is accessible to the public.

cards.title: The Speaking Tradition
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide
cards.notes: Engage in the campus-wide practice of making eye contact and saying hello to everyone you pass. It is a core part of the university's culture of civility and respect.
cards.short_summary: A formal expectation for students and faculty to greet one another while walking on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: CNU maintains a 'speaking tradition' where members of the community greet each other when passing on campus.
cards.source_title: CNU Distinctives - Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: This is a social practice observed throughout the public areas of the campus.

cards.title: Ringing the Clock Tower Bell
cards.subtitle: Christopher Newport Hall
cards.notes: Ring the bell from the SS United States after your freshman Convocation and again upon graduation. It marks the formal beginning and end of your time as a Captain.
cards.short_summary: Students ring a historic ship's bell to mark major academic milestones.
cards.evidence_claim: Freshmen ring the Clock Tower bell after Convocation, and graduates ring it again during commencement week.
cards.source_title: Traditions | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: The bell is located in the tower of Christopher Newport Hall.

cards.title: The Candlelight Ceremony
cards.subtitle: The Great Lawn
cards.notes: Gather at sundown during commencement week to light candles from one another. This solemn ritual symbolizes the passing of knowledge and the transition to alumni status.
cards.short_summary: A sunset ceremony where seniors light candles to mark their transition to alumni.
cards.evidence_claim: The Candlelight Ceremony is held at sundown the week of commencement for graduating seniors.
cards.source_title: Commencement 2026: The countdown is on! | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Held annually in May on the Great Lawn for graduating seniors and their families.

cards.title: Shoe Lane Lights
cards.subtitle: Walker's Green
cards.notes: Celebrate Homecoming Friday with live music and festive lighting at the Alumni House. This family-friendly event brings together students and alumni for a night of celebration.
cards.short_summary: A signature Homecoming event featuring live music and festive outdoor lighting.
cards.evidence_claim: Shoe Lane Lights is a free, family-friendly Homecoming tradition held on the Friday of Homecoming weekend.
cards.source_title: Homecoming 2024: Let's Celebrate | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Located at the Gregory P. Klich Alumni House; open to the public.

cards.title: Light the Night
cards.subtitle: The Great Lawn
cards.notes: Join the countdown on the Great Lawn during the first week of classes for a massive glow stick throw. It is a high-energy event to welcome new students and start the year.
cards.short_summary: A first-week tradition involving a synchronized glow stick throw on the Great Lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: Light the Night is an annual event where students gather for a countdown and glow stick throw to celebrate the new school year.
cards.source_title: Lighting up the Night - The Captain's Log
cards.access_notes: Held annually in August; open to all students.

cards.title: Alumni Alley Tailgate
cards.subtitle: Tailgate Zone
cards.notes: Visit the dedicated tailgate area during Homecoming where alumni chapters and academic departments host themed tents. It is the primary gathering spot before the football game.
cards.short_summary: The central hub for alumni and department tailgating during Homecoming weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Alumni Alley is a Homecoming tradition in the tailgate zone where various groups host tailgates for returning Captains.
cards.source_title: FAQ | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Located in the main parking lot tailgate zone; requires a pass for vehicle entry but walking through is free.

cards.title: Major Signing Day
cards.subtitle: David Student Union
cards.notes: Celebrate your transition into your chosen field of study by officially declaring your major. Faculty and department heads gather to welcome sophomores into their programs.
cards.short_summary: A formal event where sophomores declare their majors and meet department faculty.
cards.evidence_claim: Each spring, academic departments gather to welcome sophomores as they declare their majors during Signing Day.
cards.source_title: Traditions | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the spring for sophomore students.

cards.title: Holiday Lighting of the Lawn
cards.subtitle: The Great Lawn
cards.notes: Gather for the annual tree lighting ceremony featuring fireworks, crafts, and photos with Santa. This event follows the 'Holiday Happening' concert and is a community favorite.
cards.short_summary: A festive winter tradition featuring a tree lighting and fireworks on the Great Lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: The annual tree lighting on the Great Lawn is a free event open to the public, often featuring fireworks and holiday activities.
cards.source_title: Holiday Happening and Lighting of the Lawn - Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Held annually in early December; open to the public.

cards.title: The Faculty Gauntlet
cards.subtitle: Commencement Pathway
cards.notes: Walk through a line of cheering faculty members as you depart your graduation ceremony. This 'treasured tradition' serves as a final farewell from your mentors.
cards.short_summary: A graduation recessional where faculty form a celebratory line for new graduates.
cards.evidence_claim: The ceremony concludes with a grand recessional featuring the faculty gauntlet, where faculty form a line on either side of the pathway.
cards.source_title: Commencement 2026: The countdown is on! | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Occurs at the end of the main commencement ceremony on the Great Lawn.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Christopher Newport University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A guide to the essential traditions, campus hubs, and community-building events that define the first weekend for new Captains at CNU.

cards.title: Sign the Honor Code
cards.subtitle: The Great Lawn
cards.notes: Join your class on the Great Lawn to officially sign the Honor Code and receive your lucky penny, a core CNU tradition.
cards.short_summary: The official induction ceremony where freshmen commit to the university's community of honor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Community of Scholars Convocation is an annual tradition where students sign the honor code and receive a penny.
cards.source_title: Events & Traditions - CNU Alumni
cards.access_notes: Required for all first-year students during Welcome Week.

cards.title: Weekend Brunch at Regattas
cards.subtitle: David Student Union
cards.notes: Head to the DSU for a custom omelet or Belgian waffles. It is the primary social hub for weekend meals on campus.
cards.short_summary: A major campus dining hall offering made-to-order stations and a variety of international cuisines.
cards.evidence_claim: Regattas is located in the David Student Union and offers a breakfast bar with make-your-own Belgian waffles.
cards.source_title: Dining Halls | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Open for brunch and dinner on weekends during the academic semester.

cards.title: Explore the Intellectual Center
cards.subtitle: 1 Avenue of the Arts
cards.notes: Visit the library to find your favorite study nook or grab a coffee at Einstein’s Café before classes start.
cards.short_summary: The main university library featuring extensive collections, study spaces, and an on-site café.
cards.evidence_claim: Trible Library is described as the intellectual center of CNU and houses Einstein's Café.
cards.source_title: Trible Library | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Open 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. on Saturdays and noon to 9 p.m. on Sundays during the semester.

cards.title: Catch a Performance
cards.subtitle: Avenue of the Arts
cards.notes: Check the schedule for free student performances or world-class touring acts at this landmark venue.
cards.short_summary: A premier performing arts center on campus hosting concerts, theater, and university events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ferguson Center for the Arts hosts a variety of events including student activities and professional performances.
cards.source_title: Events | Ferguson Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Student ticket discounts are often available for professional shows.

cards.title: Get Active at Freeman
cards.subtitle: Fitness and Recreation
cards.notes: Visit the fitness pavilion or join a pickup game in the field house to meet other active students.
cards.short_summary: The campus hub for athletics, fitness, and large-scale student recreation events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Freeman Center features fitness facilities and is a site for student breakout sessions during orientation.
cards.source_title: Fitness Services | Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Open 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. on Saturdays and noon to 9 p.m. on Sundays.

cards.title: Visit the Geese Fountain
cards.subtitle: Trible Plaza
cards.notes: Walk by this iconic campus landmark, where you will eventually toss your lucky penny at graduation.
cards.short_summary: A central campus fountain that serves as a focal point for student traditions and photos.
cards.evidence_claim: Graduates throw their pennies into the Geese Fountain as part of a long-standing campus tradition.
cards.source_title: Events & Traditions - CNU Alumni
cards.access_notes: Located outdoors in the public plaza between the library and student union.

cards.title: Cheer on the Captains
cards.subtitle: Athletic Complex
cards.notes: Head to the stands for a soccer or field hockey game to experience the school spirit of the Marching Captains.
cards.short_summary: The primary outdoor athletic complex for CNU's varsity sports teams.
cards.evidence_claim: Captains Park includes facilities for baseball and softball, and the athletic complex hosts various varsity games.
cards.source_title: Composite Schedule - CNU Athletics
cards.access_notes: Regular season home games for most sports are free for students with ID.

cards.title: Late Night DSU Takeover
cards.subtitle: David Student Union
cards.notes: Participate in themed games, crafts, and social activities hosted by the Campus Activities Board.
cards.short_summary: A recurring late-night event series featuring interactive entertainment and snacks for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The DSU Takeover is a student event featuring arcade games, trivia, and refreshments in the David Student Union.
cards.source_title: Schedule - Christopher Newport University
cards.access_notes: Typically held on Friday or Saturday nights during Welcome Week and special weekends.

cards.entity_name: Mary M. Torggler Fine Arts Center
cards.title: Tour the Torggler
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Center
cards.notes: Walk through the rotating art galleries and admire the architecture of CNU's newest cultural landmark.
cards.short_summary: A world-class art center on campus featuring galleries, classrooms, and community programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Orientation leaders lead tours of the galleries in the Torggler Fine Arts Center for new students.
cards.source_title: Mary M. Torggler Fine Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Gallery admission is generally free to the public and students.

cards.title: Ring the Victory Bell
cards.subtitle: Clock Tower
cards.notes: After Convocation, follow the tradition of ringing the bell to mark your official start as a Captain.
cards.short_summary: A symbolic tradition where new students ring the campus bell to celebrate their arrival.
cards.evidence_claim: Incoming freshmen ring the bell after the Community of Scholars Convocation each fall.
cards.source_title: Events & Traditions - CNU Alumni
cards.access_notes: The bell is located in the tower featuring a bell from the SS United States.
